name: HotelHousekeepingBoard
tagline: Live room status, balanced attendant assignment and inspections for hotel housekeeping – inside Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: A complete housekeeping module in one PCF control: a colour-coded room board by floor, attendant columns balanced by cleaning minutes with auto-assign and drag and drop, start/finish timing with overrun alerts, an inspection queue with checklist and pass mark, Do Not Disturb, maintenance and out-of-order blocking, arrivals at risk, VIP and rush priorities, assignment sheets and CSV export. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Room status board by floor with VIP, DND, rush and at-risk flags
Status workflow Dirty → Assigned → Cleaning → Ready for inspection → Inspected, Maintenance, Out of order with allowed transitions
Cleaning minutes per service type and room type factor
Auto-assign balanced by minutes with section and floor affinity
Inspection checklist with score and pass mark – fails go back to the attendant
DND and due-out rules, minimum clean time check
Outputs and events for Power Fx and Power Automate
